import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 10 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors_breed = sns.color_palette("husl", 10)
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors_breed)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(top_breeds.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
age_order = ['0-Jährige', '1-Jährige', '2-Jährige', '3-Jährige', '4-Jährige', 
             '5-Jährige', '6-Jährige', '7-Jährige', '8-Jährige', '9-Jährige', 
             '10-Jährige', '11-Jährige', '12-Jährige', '13-Jährige', '14-Jährige',
             '15-Jährige', '16-Jährige', '17-Jährige', '18-Jährige', '19-Jährige', '20-Jährige']
age_data = [age_counts.get(age, 0) for age in age_order if age in age_counts.index]
age_labels = [age.replace('-Jährige', '') for age in age_order if age in age_counts.index]
ax2.bar(range(len(age_data)), age_data, color='steelblue', edgecolor='navy', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_labels)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_labels, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
district_labels = [str(d).replace('Kreis ', '') for d in district_counts.index]
colors_district = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_district, startangle=90)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(9)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(10)
    text.set_fontweight('bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 4. Dog Gender by Owner Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
gender_cross = pd.crosstab(df['SexLang'], df['SexHundLang'])
gender_cross.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B9D', '#4A90E2'], width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution by Owner Gender', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for container in ax4.containers:
    ax4.bar_label(container, fmt='%d', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
